item.title: A Perilous Train Ride Home in Pakistan on the Jaffer Express
item.description: The Jaffer Express is a vital lifeline through Balochistan, providing a route home for many despite crossfire. We witnessed crossfire while waiting for the Jaffer Express, a vital lifeline through Balochistan.

item.description: Carlos Prates defeated Jack Della Maddalena at UFC Fight Night in Perth. Brazil's Prates crushes hometown hero Maddalena in the Perth fight; challenges the winner of Makhachev vs Garry. Carlos Prates punishes Jack Della Maddalena at UFC Fight Night Australia.

item.title: Germany says US troop withdrawal 'foreseeable' as Trump warns of more 'cuts'
item.description: Germany says a US troop withdrawal is foreseeable as Nato seeks clarification on the decision to pull out 5,000 troops. In the US, two senior Republicans voice concern over President Trump's decision to pull out 5,000 troops.

item.description: Donald Trump said the US is unlikely to accept Iran's new peace proposal. Iran submitted a 14-point plan to Pakistan. The dour outlook came after Iran’s Tasnim and Fars news agencies said Tehran had submitted a 14-point proposal to mediator Pakistan.

item.description: The US approved $8.6 billion in arms sales to Middle East allies. US State Department cites emergency circumstances to fast-track sales without the approval of Congress. US approves $8.6bn in arms sales to Middle East allies.

item.title: DW News. . For decades, China kept its nuclear arsenal small. Under Xi Jinping, that’s changing
item.description: China is rapidly expanding its nuclear arsenal under President Xi Jinping, shifting away from decades of restraint. This change is reshaping global security dynamics. The move marks a significant departure from China's previous approach to nuclear capabilities.

item.title: Why did the UAE quit OPEC and OPEC+?
item.description: The United Arab Emirates has quit OPEC and OPEC+, citing simmering competition with Saudi Arabia. The decision may impact oil prices and the global energy market, potentially benefiting India through altered crude oil dynamics.

item.title: An Insurgency Threatens U.S. Mining Ambitions in Pakistan
item.description: The Baloch Liberation Army's insurgency threatens Pakistan's billion-dollar mining deal with the US. Attacks could derail the project, affecting US mining ambitions in the region. The development poses a challenge to Pakistan's plans.

item.title: China Invokes First-ever "Blocking Order" Against US Sanctions: Report
item.description: China invoked a "blocking order" to counter US sanctions, neutralising their extraterritorial reach. This legal mechanism marks a first for China, as it seeks to protect its interests from foreign laws.

item.description: Iran submitted a 14-point peace plan to end the war. Trump said a deal is unlikely. US Israel Iran War Ceasefire News LIVE Updates. Iran Submits 14-Point Peace Plan, Trump Says Deal 'Unlikely'.

item.title: Trump expresses doubt that Iran’s peace proposal is ‘acceptable’
item.description: Trump is considering Iran's 14-point peace plan. He warned that strikes could resume if Iran misbehaves. US president says he is considering the 14-point peace plan, but warns strikes could resume if Tehran 'misbehaves'.

item.title: Trump's New Warning To Iran On Resuming Strikes
item.description: Iran submitted a 14-point peace proposal today. US President Donald Trump responded, warning Iran it hasn't paid a "big enough price". Iran today submitted a renewed 14-point peace proposal. "Not Paid Big Enough Price": Trump's Warning As Iran Submits New Peace Plan.

item.title: Oil Tanker Hijacking Stokes Fear of Links Between Houthi Rebels and Somali Pirates
item.description: The hijacking of an oil tanker has raised concerns about potential links between Houthi rebels in Yemen and Somali pirates. The incident's location and timing fueled fears of collaboration between the two groups amid regional tensions.

item.title: Israel-Iran war highlights: Trump casts doubt on new peace proposal
item.description: US President Donald Trump will review Iran's new peace proposal. He cast doubt on the plan, which was submitted after heightened tensions between Israel and Iran. Trump said he will review the plan that Iran has sent.

item.title: North Korea's Kim casts youth as vanguard of state goals amid Russia war
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un addressed the ruling party's youth league congress in Pyongyang, mobilising citizens aged 14 to 30 to support state goals. The once-in-five-years gathering is aimed at boosting national unity and loyalty.

item.title: Trump issues stark warning to Iran over ‘Possibility’ of direct military strikes
item.description: Former US President Trump warned Iran of possible direct military strikes, escalating tensions between the two countries. The exact nature and timing of the strikes remain unclear. Trump issues stark warning to Iran over ‘Possibility’ of direct military strikes.
